brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility-chain requirements with no serious or minor errors. Doctor actively used workspace to discover hidden EHR context (diabetes, neurologic consultation, facial palsy/nystagmus findings, head MR, supportive treatments), achieving HO1. Doctor corrected specific misconception about prior albumin/fluids/potassium meaning the problem was solved, achieving HO2. Doctor dynamically reprioritized when neurologic findings were surfaced, achieving HO3. All five dimensions at good or better. Closure is safe, executable, and traceable with caregiver teach-back and explicit next steps. Three high-order points completed with meaningful trajectory impact.

closure_assessment.explanation: The trajectory concludes with a bounded episode closure: caregiver confirmed understanding of medication changes (continue nifedipine, pause irbesartan and metformin), red flag symptoms requiring immediate emergency visit, and day-5 follow-up plan. Family successfully arranged day/night supervision for toileting safety before discharge. All closure requirements met with teach-back.
